title: Sit, Stand, Walk, Fall: A State Machine That Moves Between Them Only When It Is Safe, and Refuses When It Is Not

questions.question: Why is most of the controller's work deciding what it may do next?
options: Each mode has things it may and must not do, and the robot damages itself otherwise
questions.explanation: A state machine with a check at every step.

questions.question: With knees at 0.85 of their limit the robot:
Told to sit while walking at 0.6 m/s it:
options: Slowed to a stop first and then lowered
questions.explanation: A robot that lowers at speed falls.

questions.question: A robot that fell 3 times and still tried ended in fault:
Why does a fault go to sit and not to the old state?
options: So the operator sees the reset
questions.explanation: A fault stays until it is reset.

questions.question: What is not in this lesson?
options: The motion of the legs between them
questions.explanation: The machine is told when they finish.
